webauthn.instructions.authenticate: When you continue, your browser asks for your security key or passkey.
webauthn.instructions.register: When you continue, your browser asks you to insert and touch the security key you want to add. It may also ask for the key's PIN.
webauthn.status.waiting: Insert or tap your security key, then touch it if it blinks.
webauthn.status.waiting_timeout: Insert or tap your security key, then touch it if it blinks. The request expires in {seconds} seconds.
webauthn.error.unsupported: This browser cannot use security keys or passkeys. Use another verification method or a different browser.
webauthn.error.insecure_context: Security keys only work over a secure (HTTPS) connection. Contact your administrator.
webauthn.error.invalid_options: The server sent a security key request this browser could not read. Try again or contact your administrator.
webauthn.error.cancelled: The request was cancelled or timed out. Try again when your key is ready.
webauthn.error.timeout: The security key request timed out. Try again when your key is ready.
webauthn.error.already_registered: This security key is already registered to your account.
webauthn.error.security: This site is not set up correctly for security keys (relying party or origin mismatch). Contact your administrator.
webauthn.error.not_supported: This security key or browser does not support what the server requires. Try another key.
webauthn.error.no_credential: The browser returned no credential. Try again.
webauthn.error.unknown: The security key request failed. Try again.
auth.error.key_rejected: The security key response was not accepted. Try again.
auth.error.code_rejected: The code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
auth.error.invalid_challenge: This verification has expired or was already used. Start again.
auth.error.locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.error.factor_unavailable: This verification method is unavailable right now. Use another method or try again later.
auth.error.generic: The request could not be completed. Try again.
mfa.code_instructions: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.no_usable_factor: None of your verification methods can be used here. Contact your administrator.
stepup.title: Confirm it's you
stepup.description: This action needs a second factor. Verify with one of your methods to continue. You stay signed in.
stepup.start_failed: The verification could not be started. Close this dialog and try the action again.
security.heading: Security keys and passkeys
security.description: Use a hardware security key or a passkey as a second factor when you sign in.
security.enrolled_none: No security key is registered yet.
security.load_failed: Your sign-in methods could not be loaded.
security.recovery_description: These codes are shown only once. Store them somewhere safe: each code signs you in once if you lose your key.
